title: Paper US options trading session record
description: Canonical per-session record for a PAPER-ONLY US equity options workflow (scan -> candidates -> tickets -> risk review -> approval -> simulated fill -> watch -> close). No broker, no live orders: 'executed' always means a simulated paper fill. Sourced market data is ALWAYS wrapped in a Field object (value + source_id + as_of + status). Identifiers, keys, and decisions (ticket legs, limit prices, verdicts) are plain values because they are authored by the system/user, not observed. Cross-object invariants that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in x-invariants and enforced by validate_session.py. Schema v1.1 / 1.1.1 / 1.1.2 / 1.1.3 (see CHANGELOG.md; 1.1.3 adds flag acknowledgement and specific error ids to INV-05, approval status/ticket/terms checks to INV-06, tighter INV-03/INV-04 and the new INV-16 overall-verdict consistency, same shape as 1.1.2; 1.1.2 adds INV-15 vertical stop/target comparison direction; 1.1.1 adds INV-13 credit rounding and INV-14 vertical consistency; adds per-run premarket_scans/global_snapshots, raw tick fields, trace_ref, integer open interest, 'closed' phase) is a backward-compatible superset of v1.0: every valid 1.0.0 record is a valid record under this schema.
$comment: MARKET HOURS: all US market-hours, DTE, expiry, hold-window, and 'during market hours' logic MUST be computed in America/New_York (IANA zone via zoneinfo), never by a fixed offset from Europe/Berlin. US and EU DST transitions differ: e.g. 2026-10-25 (EU ends DST) to 2026-11-01 (US ends DST) the NY-Berlin gap is 5h, so the 09:30 ET open is 14:30 Berlin, not 15:30; likewise in March (US starts 2nd Sunday, EU last Sunday). Berlin times are display-only.

x-market-hours.days: Mon-Fri excluding NYSE holidays (holiday/early-close calendar supplied by config, versioned per year)
x-market-hours.rule: Compute in America/New_York; convert to Europe/Berlin only for display. Never derive one from the other with a hardcoded 6h offset.
x-market-hours.closed_definition: Run phase 'closed' (v1.1): NY wall clock before 04:00 or at/after the regular close (16:00; 13:00 on early-close days) on a trading day, or any time on a weekend / NYSE holiday. Holiday and early-close dates come from risk_rules.yaml config.market_hours.

x-invariants: INV-01 every source_id referenced anywhere exists in sources[].id

INV-02 every TsPair has ny and berlin denoting the same instant; ny offset is -04:00 or -05:00 and matches America/New_York DST for that instant; berlin offset is +01:00 or +02:00 and matches Europe/Berlin

INV-03 ids are unique within their array (sources, runs, candidates, contracts, tickets, legs, reviews, approvals, positions, watches, alerts, ideas, events). Enforced for every version on the top-level arrays; 1.1.3 records also: leg_id and contract_id unique within each ticket's legs (INV-03-LEG), contract_id unique within each option_chain_slice (INV-03-CONTRACT), fill_id unique across all paper_positions (INV-03-FILL)

INV-04 all *_id references resolve (run_id, candidate_id, ticket_id, review_id, approval_id, position_id, watch_id, event_id, contract_id, leg_id). 1.1.3 records also: every paper_positions[].fills[].leg_id is a leg of the position's ticket (INV-04-FILL-LEG) and its contract_id equals that leg's contract_id (INV-04-FILL-CONTRACT); every marks[].leg_marks[].leg_id is a leg of the position's ticket (INV-04-MARK-LEG)

INV-05 an approval may only reference a review whose overall.verdict is PASS or FLAG, for the same ticket, and its legs/quantity/limit_price must equal the ticket's exactly. 1.1.3 records: expires_at > approved_at, and an approval of a FLAG review must acknowledge every flagged rule_id in acknowledged_flags and nothing else: flagged = results FLAG or UNKNOWN with severity soft (risk_reference.overall) plus any recorded overall.flag_rule_ids (INV-05-ACK-MISSING: a flagged id is not listed, an absent acknowledged_flags lists nothing; INV-05-ACK-EXTRA: a listed id was not flagged, incl. any id on a PASS review; INV-05-ACK-DUPLICATE: an id listed twice). Specific error ids: INV-05-VETO (recorded overall.verdict VETO, or its rule results give VETO, or it has no rule results), INV-05-FOREIGN (review for another ticket), INV-05-TERMS (legs/quantity/limit_price differ from the ticket), INV-05-EXPIRY (expires_at <= approved_at). Acknowledgement is not evaluated for a VETO review (already INV-05-VETO). 1.1.6 records: approved_at / expires_at / status_changed_at must carry a UTC offset and parse (INV-05-TIME-NAIVE / INV-05-TIME-INVALID, reported instead of crashing; the schema TsPair pattern already rejects them, the ids name the cause), and the VETO / flag derivation uses the fail-closed aggregate (INV-16)

INV-06 a paper_position requires an approval with status active at every fill time; every opening fill price respects the approved limit (debit <= limit, credit >= limit). 1.1.3 records (approvals[].status is the canonical approval state; there is no 'decision' field): the approval must be active at every opening fill: status 'active', or 'revoked'/'expired'/'consumed' with status_changed_at strictly after the fill (INV-06-STATUS: status changed at or before an opening fill, so a 'consumed' stamp must come after the last opening fill; INV-06-STATUS-UNDATED: non-active status without status_changed_at); the approval must be for the position's ticket (INV-06-TICKET) and its legs/quantity/limit_price must equal that ticket's (INV-06-TERMS); it must not approve a VETO review (INV-06-VETO); every opening fill satisfies approved_at <= filled_at <= expires_at (INV-06-BEFORE / INV-06-EXPIRED); opening fills match the approved leg side (buy -> buy_to_open, sell -> sell_to_open) and per leg total opening qty <= approval.quantity * ratio (INV-06-QTY); entry net per spread unit = sum(+price*qty buy_to_open, -price*qty sell_to_open) / approval.quantity respects the limit in exact Decimal (INV-06-LIMIT). Closing fills are not time-limited by expires_at. 1.1.6 records (SOL-ACCEPT-001 G4): the approval is valid only while approved_at < t < expires_at, strict at both ends, compared as instants whatever the UTC offset: every opening fill needs approved_at < filled_at (INV-06-BEFORE, so a fill at approved_at is invalid) and filled_at < expires_at (INV-06-EXPIRED, so a fill exactly at expires_at is invalid; 1.1.3-1.1.5 records keep approved_at <= filled_at <= expires_at); a naive or unparsable filled_at / approval time is INV-06-TIME-NAIVE / INV-06-TIME-INVALID (never a crash; the time comparisons for that fill are skipped, the error itself fails the record). The watcher uses the same open window at its poll time (watcher_reference.real_approval).
INV-07 idea_log history is chronological and current_status equals the last history entry's status
INV-08 a ticket's legs reference contract_ids present in the referenced candidate's option_chain_slices
INV-09 Field.as_of must be <= the fetched_at of its source when status is ok or stale (data cannot be newer than its fetch)

INV-10 (v1.1) run phase vs NY clock: 'closed' requires schema_version 1.1.0, 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 or 1.1.6 and runs[].started (America/New_York) in the closed window (before 04:00, at/after 16:00 or the 13:00 early close, weekend, NYSE holiday per risk_rules.yaml config.market_hours); in 1.1.x records every run started in that window must have phase 'closed' and 'afterhours' is not used

INV-11 (v1.1) trace_ref requires schema_version 1.1.0, 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 or 1.1.6; when validating a file, trace_ref.path resolves inside the record's directory, exists, and its SHA-256 equals trace_ref.sha256

INV-12 (v1.1) premarket_scans[] and global_snapshots[] require schema_version 1.1.0, 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 or 1.1.6; within each array run_id is unique and references an existing runs[].run_id; when the singular premarket_scan / global_snapshot is also present its run_id must appear in the array

INV-13 (v1.1) raw tick fields (limit_price.raw_amount/tick_size/rounding; Condition.raw_value/tick_size/rounding on ticket entry/exit/stop/target rules and watcher_rules) require schema_version 1.1.0, 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 or 1.1.6; tick_size must equal the tick rule for the ticket's underlying at the raw price (risk_rules.yaml config.tick_rules); rounded == round(raw, tick_size, rounding) exactly (Decimal); debit limit rounds down, stop conditions round up, target conditions round down; for 1.1.1, 1.1.2 and 1.1.3 records credit verticals (bull_put_credit_spread, bear_call_credit_spread) must round the min-credit limit up, stop conditions down and target conditions up

INV-14 (1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 and 1.1.6 records) vertical tickets (bull_call_debit_spread, bear_put_debit_spread, bull_put_credit_spread, bear_call_credit_spread): legs must form the declared vertical (2 legs, same type and expiry, 1:1, one buy one sell, strikes in the right order, matching price_type); width, strikes and the LIMIT price (max debit / min credit) come from the legs and limit_price; stop/target = the position_value condition (cost to close) in stop_rules/target_rules (exactly one each). Credit: 0 < credit < width; credit < stop < width; 0 <= target < credit; max_loss = (width - credit)*100*qty; max_profit = credit*100*qty; breakeven = short_strike - credit (put) / + credit (call); (stop - credit)*100*qty <= max_loss. Debit: 0 < debit < width; 0 < stop < debit; debit < target <= width; max_loss = debit*100*qty; max_profit = (width - debit)*100*qty; breakeven = long_strike + debit (call) / - debit (put). Stored max_loss/max_profit amount_usd and the breakeven at the limit must equal the computed values (0.01 tolerance on $ amounts), unlimited false, at_price (if set) = limit; any other breakevens[] must match the formula at their own at_price. Exact Decimal arithmetic; inequalities strict as written.

INV-15 (1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 and 1.1.6 records) vertical tickets: the comparison operator of the single position_value condition (cost to close; the same condition INV-14 reads) in stop_rules and in target_rules. Debit verticals (bull_call_debit_spread, bear_put_debit_spread): stop op 'lte', target op 'gte'. Credit verticals (bull_put_credit_spread, bear_call_credit_spread), where position_value is the cost to buy the spread back: stop op 'gte', target op 'lte'. A missing or duplicate condition is reported by INV-14 only.

INV-16 (1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 and 1.1.6 records only) overall-verdict consistency: every risk_reviews[].overall must equal risk_reference.overall(results): verdict exactly (INV-16-VERDICT), blocking_rule_ids as a set without duplicates (INV-16-BLOCKING: VETO or hard UNKNOWN), flag_rule_ids as a set without duplicates (INV-16-FLAGS: FLAG or soft UNKNOWN); so a stored PASS/FLAG over any VETO or hard UNKNOWN fails. A review with no rule results fails (INV-16-EMPTY; risk_reference.combine([]) is UNKNOWN, fail closed). Precedence within a rule: PASS < FLAG < UNKNOWN < VETO (risk_reference.combine). 1.1.6 records (SOL-ACCEPT-001 G3) are recomputed fail closed (risk_reference.overall / classify): a result that is not exactly PASS/FLAG/UNKNOWN/VETO counts as VETO and an UNKNOWN whose severity is missing or not hard/soft counts as hard (blocking), never PASS; 1.1.3-1.1.5 records use the frozen aggregate (risk_reference.overall_v115). For schema-valid results both are identical

INV-17 (1.1.6 records only, SOL-ACCEPT-001 G6) one approval opens at most one position: every approvals[].approval_id is referenced by at most one paper_positions[].approval_id (INV-17-REUSE, reported once per reused approval and naming every position; the first position in array order is the one it opened). Ticket binding is INV-06-TICKET / INV-04-FILL-LEG; the watcher does not evaluate positions.

schema_version.description: 1.0.0 = v1 record; 1.1.0 = may use v1.1 additions (run phase 'closed', trace_ref, premarket_scans/global_snapshots, raw tick fields); 1.1.1 = same shape as 1.1.0 plus the stricter checks INV-13 credit directions and INV-14 vertical consistency; 1.1.2 = same shape and checks as 1.1.1 plus INV-15 vertical stop/target comparison direction. Integer open_interest applies to all (integral floats like 472.0 still validate). 1.1.3 = same shape as 1.1.2 plus stricter checks on 1.1.3 records only: INV-03 leg/contract/fill uniqueness, INV-04 fill/leg_mark leg and contract resolution, INV-05 flag acknowledgement and specific error ids, INV-06 approval status/ticket/terms at fills, INV-16 overall verdict = aggregate of rule results. Records 1.0.0-1.1.2 validate exactly as before (same error strings). 1.1.4 = same shape and checks as 1.1.3 (no new invariants; spec 1.1.4 changed tests, fixtures and the watcher approval mapping only); everything described as '1.1.3 records' below applies to 1.1.4 records too, and 1.1.3 records validate exactly as before. 1.1.5 = same shape and checks as 1.1.3 / 1.1.4 (no new invariants; spec 1.1.5 changed the watcher target mapping only); everything described as '1.1.3 records' below applies to 1.1.5 records too, and 1.1.4 and older records validate exactly as before. 1.1.6 = same shape as 1.1.5 plus stricter checks on 1.1.6 records only (SOL-ACCEPT-001): INV-06 open fill window approved_at < filled_at < expires_at (a fill exactly at expires_at or at approved_at is invalid; 1.1.3-1.1.5 keep the closed window), naive / unparsable approval and fill times are INV-05-TIME-NAIVE / INV-06-TIME-NAIVE (-INVALID) errors, never a crash, the new INV-17 (one approval opens at most one position, INV-17-REUSE) and the fail-closed INV-16 recompute (an unrecognised result or UNKNOWN without severity is blocking); everything described as '1.1.3 records' below applies to 1.1.6 records too, and 1.1.5 and older records validate exactly as before (same error strings).

id.description: sess-YYYY-MM-DD[-suffix]; date part = US trading date in America/New_York

mode.description: Paper only. Any other value is invalid by design.

risk_ruleset_version.description: version of risk_rules.yaml used by reviews in this session

regular_open.description: 09:30 ET on session.date, with Berlin equivalent computed via zoneinfo

ny_berlin_offset_hours.description: Informational only: 6 normally, 5 during DST-mismatch weeks. Never used for computation.

url.description: https URL; 'urn:poodle:derived' for values the pipeline computed

realtime.description: Whether the source claims realtime data

runs.description: Each pipeline pass within the session (premarket scan, preopen update, post-open requote...). Time-varying records point at a run_id.

phase.description: Computed on the America/New_York clock from started. closed (v1.1 only) = before 04:00 or at/after the regular close (16:00, 13:00 on early-close days) on a trading day, or a weekend / NYSE holiday. In 1.1.x records a run started in that window MUST be 'closed' and 'closed' MUST NOT be used outside it (INV-10); 'afterhours' remains valid only in 1.0.0 records.

market_status.description: e.g. Pre-Market / Open / Closed as reported by the quote source

items.description: One row per (ticker, run_id): later runs append rows rather than overwrite, so history is preserved.

premarket_scans.description: (v1.1, 1.1.0 / 1.1.1 / 1.1.2 / 1.1.3 / 1.1.4 / 1.1.5 / 1.1.6 records only) one premarket scan per run, keyed by run_id (unique; each must reference an existing runs[].run_id, INV-12). 'premarket_scan', if present, is kept for v1 readers and must be one of these entries (same run_id).

global_snapshots.description: (v1.1, 1.1.0 / 1.1.1 / 1.1.2 / 1.1.3 / 1.1.4 / 1.1.5 / 1.1.6 records only) one global snapshot per run, keyed by run_id (unique; each must reference an existing runs[].run_id, INV-12). 'global_snapshot', if present, is kept for v1 readers and must be one of these entries (same run_id).

event_calendar.description: Scheduled events the risk rules need (earnings, ex-dividend, CPI, PPI, FOMC, NFP). 'coverage' records how far each calendar was actually checked, so 'no event found' (PASS) is distinguishable from 'never checked' (UNKNOWN).

scheduled_at.description: Event instant (America/New_York offset). If time unknown, use 00:00 NY and timing=unknown; rules then treat the whole NY calendar day as the event.

dividend_amount.description: ex_dividend only: cash dividend per share

checked_through.description: Calendar verified complete through this NY date (inclusive). status missing => not checked.

iv30_history.description: trailing 30 calendar days of daily IV30 closes, oldest first

label.const: HYPOTHETICAL - paper only, not an order

quantity.description: number of spread units; leg contracts = quantity * leg.ratio

reference_mid.description: net per-share price at leg mids (debit positive)

natural.description: net per-share price crossing the spread

status.description: worst status among the leg quotes used

risk_basis.description: e.g. which per-trade limit was used (placeholder until Eugene sets one)

end.description: time stop / latest planned exit (<= expiry 16:00 ET)

intended_event_ids.description: events the ticket deliberately holds through (e.g. an earnings play); lets the earnings rule FLAG instead of VETO

measured.description: value the formula produced (number, string, object, or null when UNKNOWN)

placeholder.description: threshold is a placeholder default pending Eugene

verdict.description: VETO if any rule VETO or any hard rule UNKNOWN; else FLAG if any FLAG or soft UNKNOWN; else PASS; 1.1.3 records: must equal risk_reference.overall(results) (INV-16), as must blocking_rule_ids and flag_rule_ids (as sets)

blocking_rule_ids.description: rule_ids whose result is VETO, or UNKNOWN with severity hard (1.1.3: INV-16)

flag_rule_ids.description: rule_ids whose result is FLAG, or UNKNOWN with severity soft; an approval must acknowledge each (1.1.3: INV-05)

approval_required.description: Always true: even PASS needs explicit contract-level approval

approvals.description: Contract-level approvals. Bound to exact legs + quantity + limit; any change requires a new approval. Never valid for a VETO review. The approval state is approvals[].status (canonical; there is no 'decision' field and additionalProperties is false, so a 'decision' key is a schema error): only 'active' is a usable approval; 'expired', 'revoked', 'consumed' or no approval mean NOT approved for a new entry. A rejected idea is idea_log current_status 'rejected', not an approval field.

evidence.description: message id / UI click log reference

expires_at.description: default: same NY trading day regular close; must be > approved_at

acknowledged_flags.description: FLAG rule_ids the approver explicitly accepted. 1.1.3 (INV-05): must equal the review's flagged rule_ids exactly (FLAG or soft UNKNOWN results): no missing, no extra, no duplicates; empty or absent for a PASS review.

status.description: Canonical approval state (consumers must read this field; there is no 'decision' field). active = approved and usable until expires_at; consumed = used by a paper position; expired / revoked = not approved. 1.1.3 (INV-06): an opening fill is valid only while the approval is active (status_changed_at strictly after the fill for any non-active status).

status_changed_at.description: when status last changed; 1.1.3: required for any status other than 'active' (INV-06)

position_value.description: net per-share value of the structure

conditions.description: ANY condition true -> alert (OR); use separate watches for AND

active.description: false = defined only (e.g. ticket not yet approved)

schedule.description: cron in America/New_York, or null if no schedule created

data_quality.description: Derived index of non-ok Fields (JSON Pointer paths) for the UI; must be regenerable from the record.

trace_ref.description: Optional (v1.1). Hand-off trace written next to this record, not embedded. When validate_session.py is given a file, it checks the trace exists and its SHA-256 matches (INV-11).

path.description: relative to this record's directory; no absolute paths or '..' segments

sha256.description: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the trace file bytes

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 with explicit offset (naive timestamps forbidden)

TsPair.description: Same instant in America/New_York and Europe/Berlin (INV-02).

OccSymbol.description: OCC symbol without padding, e.g. JPM261030C00340000

IdeaStatus.description: simulated = paper order working in simulator; executed = simulated paper fill done (position open); never a broker order

Field.description: A sourced datum. status: ok = fresh & single-valued; stale = value present but older than freshness policy or from a prior session; missing = not obtained (value null); conflicting = sources disagree (value null, all candidates in conflicts[] side by side, >=2). Consumers (risk rules) treat missing and conflicting as UNKNOWN input.

as_of.description: instant the value refers to (quote time), not fetch time

ratio.description: contracts per spread unit; total = ticket.quantity * ratio

amount.description: net per-share price of one spread unit

valid_only_if.description: human-readable precondition, e.g. re-quoted live after 09:30 ET

raw_amount.description: (v1.1) unrounded price before tick rounding; amount = round(raw_amount, tick_size, rounding)

tick_size.description: tick grid used (INV-13: penny-pilot names 0.01 below $3.00 / 0.05 at or above; others 0.05 / 0.10; tier by the raw price)

rounding.description: direction applied to the raw value: down = floor, up = ceiling, nearest = half-up, none = no rounding (rounded must equal raw). Required directions (INV-13): debit limit down, stop up, target down.

amount_usd.description: for whole ticket (quantity included); null only if unlimited

at_price.description: net per-share price the amount assumes (normally limit_price.amount)

raw_value.description: (v1.1) unrounded threshold before tick rounding; value = round(raw_value, tick_size, rounding)

tick_size.description: tick grid used (INV-13: penny-pilot names 0.01 below $3.00 / 0.05 at or above; others 0.05 / 0.10; tier by the raw price)

rounding.description: direction applied to the raw value: down = floor, up = ceiling, nearest = half-up, none = no rounding (rounded must equal raw). Required directions (INV-13): debit limit down, stop up, target down.

directions.other / watcher conditions: any (consistency only); credit in 1.1.0 records: any

x-validator-contract: validate_session.py CLI: exit 0 only when every given file was read, parsed as a JSON object and validated with no errors; exit 1 when any record has schema/invariant errors (an unknown schema_version is a schema error); exit 2 when any file cannot be read or parsed, is not a JSON object, or the validator raises. Consumers must treat any non-zero exit, and a missing or unimportable validate_session.py, as FAIL (fail closed).
